summary: Upstream rpiv-mono v2.15.0 is merged (staged, not yet committed) on sync/upstream-v2.15.0, with all fork customizations kept and Firecrawl-only key counting for provider visibility.

rpiv-web-tools gained a fork-only Anthropic web search provider (Pi login first, API key second), a once-only search fallback, and a separate fetchProvider; verified by tests, two passing reviews, and one live search, then archived as completed (uncommitted).

rpiv-voice's decibri and sherpa-onnx-node moved to optionalDependencies so the fork's root npm install passes on Termux (android); verified by a spoofed-platform install, npm ci, tests, and a passing review, then archived as completed (uncommitted, phone check pending a push).
